observations.origin403Note: Server-side curl to http://127.0.0.1/ with Host header returned 403 during Phase 1 deploy — LiteSpeed origin guard, not Next.js app logic
observations.crawlerRiskAssessment: Intermittent Hostinger CDN/WAF may return 429 for some browser-like automated probes. Repository validators use audit UA. Do not infer crawler support from UA spoofing alone.
observations.securityImplications: No WAF weakening recommended in Phase 2A
